---
title: "RSS Climate Slides"
author: "Climate Change Response Program"
date: today
date-format: short
format:
  pptx:
    slide-level: 2
    reference-doc: "RSS-Climate-Slides-Template.pptx"
params:
  # ============================
  # USER INPUTS (UPDATE THESE)
  # ============================
  SiteID: "ISRO"                          # Park short code (e.g., ISRO, GRCA)
  LongName: "Isle Royale National Park"   # Full park name
  CF_selected: "WarmWet_HotDry"           # Options: "WarmWet_HotDry" or "WarmDry_HotWet"
  Base_Park_Dir: "E:/RCF_2024/RCF_opened" # Parent directory containing park folders
  map_csv: "climate-metric-title.csv"     # CSV mapping filenames → slide titles
---

```{r setup}
## ======================================================
## Setup & Data Preparation (do not edit unless needed)
## ======================================================

# LIBRARIES

library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(tools)

# PARAMETERS

SiteID        <- params$SiteID
CF_selected   <- params$CF_selected
Base_Park_Dir <- params$Base_Park_Dir
MapCSV        <- params$map_csv

# DIRECTORY STRUCTURE

# Base_Park_Dir/
# └── ISRO/
# ├── WarmWet_HotDry/
# │   └── figures/
# └── WarmDry_HotWet/
#     └── figures/

Park_Dir <- file.path(Base_Park_Dir, SiteID)

CFDir <- if (CF_selected == "WarmWet_HotDry") {
  file.path(Park_Dir, "WarmWet_HotDry")
} else {
  file.path(Park_Dir, "WarmDry_HotWet")
}

FigDir <- file.path(CFDir, "figures")

# READ TITLE / SUBHEADING MAP

title_map <- read_csv(MapCSV, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
mutate(
  file_name  = str_trim(tolower(file_name)),
  title      = str_trim(title),
  subheading = str_trim(subheading)
  ) %>%
  select(file_name, title, subheading)

# COLLECT FIGURES

fig_files <- list.files(
  FigDir,
  pattern = "/.(png|jpg|jpeg|tif|tiff|gif|bmp|svg)$",
  full.names = TRUE,
  ignore.case = TRUE
  ) %>%
  sort()
```

```{r slide-builder}
## ======================================================
## Slide Builder Function
## ======================================================

make_slide <- function(img_path) {
  
  file_base <- basename(img_path)
  file_key  <- tolower(file_base)
  
  match_row <- title_map %>% filter(file_name == file_key)
  
  slide_title <- if (nrow(match_row) == 1 && nzchar(match_row$title)) {
    match_row$title
    } else {
      toTitleCase(gsub("[-_]+", " ", file_path_sans_ext(file_base)))
      }
  
  slide_subhead <- if (nrow(match_row) == 1 && nzchar(match_row$subheading)) {
    match_row$subheading
    } else {
      ""
      }
  
  # Normalize file path for Windows
  
  img_path_clean <- gsub(
    "\\\\", "/",
    normalizePath(img_path, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
    )
  
  # Emit slide
  
  cat("## ", slide_title, "\n\n", sep = "")
  if (slide_subhead != "") cat(slide_subhead, "\n\n")
  cat("![](", img_path_clean, "){width=10in height=7.5in}\n\n", sep = "")
}
```

```{r generate-slides, results='asis', echo=FALSE}
## ======================================================
## Generate PowerPoint Slides
## ======================================================

for (img in fig_files) {
  make_slide(img)
}
```
